messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for RAFA Club Gosport?
messages.body: Hi Natalie Thank you, I will let you know. I'll have to take to the committee. Can you send me the link to his clips again please. Note we can only afford one band / singer a month. All other solos do is a charity deal of £200-250. We are a small venue too with generally an over 50 population unless followers join a band night ( we charge £2pp temp membership for non-members, on a soloist night) Thanks Tracey
